title: Tharp and Heezen ocean-floor maps of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge
summary: Marie Tharp, working at Columbia's Lamont observatory from 1948, plotted echo-sounding profiles across the North Atlantic that showed a rift valley along the crest of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. With Bruce Heezen she published ocean-floor maps from 1957, including the 1959 North Atlantic diagram, and earthquake epicentres fell within the valley.

uncertainty.note: Sources date the first maps to 1957 and the Geological Society of America North Atlantic diagram to 1959; the recognition of the rift is dated only to the 1950s.

as_recorded.value: 1957 Tharp and Heezen began publishing their first comprehensive ocean-floor maps; 1959 GSA published The Floors of the Oceans: I. The North Atlantic
1948 Tharp joined Lamont; 1957 Heezen presented the expanding rift system; 1959 The Floors of the Oceans
